topic: Sensor data issues in multiple regions
summary_markdown: Concerns were raised regarding potential data drops for sensors in specific international locations. Specifically, the conversation noted possible data dips for Brazil starting April 3rd and a complete traffic drop observed in Gabon on April 5th. Additionally, an issue was reported concerning two sensors where the signal is present but the packets are empty. It was confirmed that follow-up regarding antenna checks in Africa (a previously reported complaint) would be handled.
decisions: Investigate data anomalies for Brazil and Gabon.
action_items: Check sensor data and address connectivity issues in specified African locations.
